messages:
anya-sales: Quick — Aurora needs a hosted POC key for demo in 18h. Requirements: 7d TTL, scopes: generation only, IP allowlist 192.0.2.0/24, soft 6 rps / hard 12 rps, billing tag sales/aurora/poc. Can infra provision?

kevin-se: I can. Plan: create key named sales-aurora-poc-2026, TTL 7d, tag, quotas, IP allowlist, enable audit 90d. Deliver via 1Password secure link.

maria-sec: Checklist: HTTPS only, IP enforced, audit retention 90d, tag for billing. If they later need KMS/HSM escalate to Private.

ops-bot: Staging key k_stg_aur_01 created for verification.

kevin-se: Prod key created k_aur73 (masked). Stored in 1Password at /shared/sales/aurora/poc/key-2026. Added ticket RH-POC-9944 note with rotation plan.

anya-sales: Thanks — CS will test from their CIDR and confirm. Rotation playbook: create new key, customer hot-swap header, verify 15m, then revoke old.

maria-sec: On accidental exposure: revoke immediately, create replacement, run usage replay and notify security.

kevin-se: Revocation API:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/k_aur73/revoke" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```

anya-sales: Marking thread resolved once CS confirms connectivity.
